readings: Linking each budget line to its event (`event.event_id` = `budget.link_to_event`, exact text match; lines without a matching event are dropped), keep only budget lines whose `spent` is strictly greater than 6.0. For each event `status`, show the status, the average of (`amount` minus `spent`) computed per budget line (ignoring missing values; blank if there are none), and the number of such budget lines. Leave the results unrounded.

Linking each budget line to its event (`event.event_id` = `budget.link_to_event`, exact text match; lines without a matching event are dropped), keep only budget lines whose `spent` is greater than or equal to 6.0 (so lines with `spent` exactly 6.0 are included). For each event `status`, show the status, the average of (`amount` minus `spent`) computed per budget line (ignoring missing values; blank if there are none), and the number of such budget lines. Leave the results unrounded.
queries:
SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent), COUNT(*)
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status;
SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent), COUNT(*)
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent >= 6.0
GROUP BY e.status;
